Conley & Stephenson Law Group
Baytown, TX
Phone 281-555-9622
Letter of Representation
December 24, 2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1487
Our client: Zachary Huerta
Date of loss: October 22, 2023
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision described
in your file, and all further communication regarding this matter should be directed
to our office and not to our client. Please do not contact our client by telephone,
mail, or in person, and please refer any inquiries from others acting on the insurer's
behalf to us as well.
The collision was a low-speed head-on impact, and our client sustained injuries that
are currently under medical evaluation and treatment. We are gathering the medical and
billing records needed to document the full extent of those injuries and will forward
them once they are available.
We request that you provide a certified copy of the declarations page and the policy
limits for all coverages that may apply to this loss, including bodily injury
liability, any excess or umbrella coverage, and any other potentially responsive
coverage held by your insured. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this
matter.
Finally, we ask that the insurer preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This
includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, witness statements,
recorded calls, claim notes, adjuster reports, repair and total-loss valuations, and
any telematics or dashcam footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of
these materials until this matter is resolved.
Sincerely,
Jennifer Williams
Conley & Stephenson Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
